description: R3 discrimination (PR-F): frozen run configuration for every arm. All numbers in the PR trace to these settings + the frozen qid/config files.

t_a.purpose: S1 artifact discrimination: 4 prompts (2 from the 82k cluster, 2 from the 75-77k cluster; deterministic pick recorded in PR)
t_a.primary_path: sglang (kvoffload-sglang-c2kv fork, c2kv components OFF, tool parser OFF), base model models/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, attention-backend=ascend, dtype=bfloat16, mem-fraction-static=0.7, context-length=131072, temperature=0, max_new_tokens=128; input = exact S1 full-arm token ids (agent/r3_extract_prompts.py), raw text via /generate (agent/r3_sglang_rawtext.py)
t_a.secondary_path: HF eager + chunked prefill (agent/r3_chunked_prefill_probe.py), same checkpoint-250 gist-class model object as the S1 full arm, chunk=128 after 2048/512 OOMed (fp32 eager softmax over ~82k KV)

t_b.purpose: 32k truncation retest of the same 48 qids (length- vs sample-driven)
t_b.cap_semantics: chat-templated tool-document ids truncated at 32000 tokens (same token-level idiom as harness mode=truncate); doc_tokens_full recorded per row

t_e.c2kv_arm: agent/r3_bigpool_rerun.py --arm c2kv --ratio 4 --max_doc_length 512 --max_doc_num 160 (1024x96 OOMed at 76-82k pools -> pre-authorized halving; same 97k token budget, finer chunks, chunk count 147-157 > 96 widens the compressor OOD caveat)
t_e.trusted_full_arm: same 48 qids through the T-A sglang base-model path (only because T-A overturned the S1 collapse)
t_e.fair_compare: Wilson 95% bounds on call rate; c2kv tool_name acc vs prior arm 0.1875

t_c.length_replay: agent/r3_d1prime_length_replay.py executed against the task/r2-d1prime module tree (read-only) for pipeline fidelity; donor map replayed with batch=1 seed=0 per readout.log; window cap 256

t_d.rerun: agent/analyze_trigger_signals.py (+S0.logp_prefix_full.pos diagnostic entry) on outputs_lyc/r2_logp/s4_logp_clean.jsonl + merged_{A,B,C,D}.jsonl, --bootstrap_reps 20000 --bootstrap_seed 0

env.sglang_server: fresh venv (torch 2.8.0+cpu, torch_npu 2.8.0, triton-ascend 3.2.0, sgl_kernel_npu 2026.6.1, setuptools<81 for pkg_resources), CANN 8.5.0 + nnal/atb
env.device_pinning: T-B dev0, sglang dev1, T-E dev2, probe dev0 (sequential)
